attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 with a PAM limits.d drop-in (/etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf) setting nofile=8192 and nproc=256 (soft and hard) for its login sessions. Verified via a real login shell (`su -l`/`sudo -u appworker -i`) before and after a full node restart, confirming both persistence and correctness.
